TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general strength and cardiovascular fitness within moderate-intensity, post-MI safety constraints"
  GOAL secondary weight_loss:
    name "Facilitate gradual weight loss with increased cardio volume within medical guidance"
  GOAL tertiary test_ready:
    name "Progressively build toward a 5K time trial test at week 12"
  GOAL summary_plan:
    name "Deliver a cohesive 12-week plan integrating strength, cardio, nutrition, HIIT considerations, and progressive 5K readiness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Intro to compound lifts with safety focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 set
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility and light compound emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 6 minutes easy
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 set
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core, conditioning, and safe squats":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 each side
        cardio:
          rower 6 minutes easy-moderate
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 1 set
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Progressive load with safety in squats and pulling":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 10 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 set
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility and safety cues":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          treadmill walk 6 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1 set
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core, balance, and light compound work":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 2x12 each side
        cardio:
          rowing 6 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 1 set
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Structured strength progression with compounds":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          bike intervals: 2 x (4 minutes at moderate, 2 minutes recover)
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 set
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Mobility and higher cardio volume with pacing prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 8 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1 set
      DAY Friday training 55m "Legs, core, and cardio engine":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x30 seconds
        cardio:
          treadmill incline walk 10 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1 set
      HIIT CONSIDERATION
        - If cleared, include optional brief HIIT blocks after strength days (low volume, monitored).
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Tempo cardio integration with strength and distance pacing":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          incline walk or cycle 12 minutes steady with 2 minutes easy
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 set
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Stability, control, and distance pacing prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 8 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 1 set
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core, posture, and distance endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hollow_hold 3x30 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 each side
          russian_twist 3x12 each side
        cardio:
          cycling 10 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1 set
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Build toward 5K time trial readiness":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          treadmill walk/run progression: 4 minutes run, 2 minutes walk, repeat 2x
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1 set
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Mobility, compounds, and distance pacing":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 8 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1 set
      DAY Friday training 60m "Power-build day with safe lifting":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x15 rpe 4
        cardio:
          cycling 6 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 1 set
    HIIT CONSIDERATION
      - If cleared, include optional brief HIIT blocks after strength days (low volume, monitored).
NUTRITION PLAN
  GOALS
    GOAL primary nutrition:
      name "Cardiac health-focused nutrition to support exercise, energy, and heart health"
  GUIDING PRINCIPLES
    - Continue heart-healthy deficit approach if weight loss goals persist.
  DAILY NUTRITION FRAMEWORK
    CALORIE RANGE
      - Target: modest energy deficit; adjust with clinician/dietitian input.
    MACROS
      - Protein: 1.2–1.5 g/kg
      - Carbohydrates: 3–4.5 g/kg
      - Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg
    FIBER
      - 25–35 g/day
    SODIUM
      - ≤1500–2300 mg/day
  MEAL TIMING
    - 3 main meals + 1–2 snacks
    - Pre-workout: small balanced snack 60–90 minutes before training
    - Post-workout: protein + carbs within 1–2 hours
  FOOD PRIORITIES
    - Heart-healthy protein, whole grains, healthy fats, vegetables and fruits, sodium management
  SAMPLE DAILY FRAME
    Breakfast: Oats with berries, chia, yogurt
    Snack: Apple + almonds
    Lunch: Grilled chicken, quinoa, vegetables, olive oil
    Snack: Carrot sticks with hummus
    Dinner: Baked salmon, broccoli, brown rice
  TRAINING-NUTRITION CONNECTION
    - Hydration; post-training protein 20–30 g with carbs
    - Sodium around workouts mindful
  SUPPLEMENTS
    - As advised by clinician
  MONITORING AND SAFETY
    - Weekly weight check; report BP changes
  IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
    - Tailor portions; consult dietitian
  CARDIO INTENSITY ADJUSTMENTS
    - Increase cardio volume and/or intensity within safe limits to promote energy expenditure while staying under physician guidance
    - Use RPE targets and heart-rate zones aligned to medical clearance; monitor symptoms continuously
  HIIT PROTOCOL CONSIDERATION (LATER PHASES)
    - If physician approves, introduce very brief HIIT blocks after a progressive buildup:
      - Phase 2: 1 session per week with 1–2 intervals per workout
      - Phase 3/4: 2 sessions per week max, intervals 15–20 seconds at RPE 8 with ample recovery (2–3 minutes)
      - Structure: 5–8 minutes total including warmup/cooldown
      - Alternatives: upper-body or lower-body low-impact intervals
  5K TIME TRIAL PROGRESSION
    - Phase 3, Week 1–2: distance/pacing prep with walk/run intervals
    - Phase 3, Week 2–4: longer continuous blocks as tolerated
    - Week 4–12: gradual increase toward 5K test at week 12 with clinician clearance

MONITORING AND SAFETY
  - Monthly medical check-ins to assess MI recovery status and readiness for longer endurance efforts.
  - Continuous symptom check during cardio; watch for chest pain, undue shortness of breath, dizziness.
  - Adjust plan based on BP responses, fatigue, and physician guidance.

Notes:
- All workouts maintain heart rate within physician-approved zones; progression is contingent on tolerance and safety.
- Max lifts are avoided; compound lifts included with conservative loading.
- HIIT remains conditional on clearance and safety monitoring.
